title: The Star Quality of New Zealand's Great Barrier Island ｜ 新西兰大屏障岛的星空之美

sents.en: I was glad I had such terrible jetlag.
sents.cn: 我真庆幸自己经历了如此严重的时差反应。

sents.en: Wide awake at 3:30 am with our nine-year-old daughter on our lodge balcony, I stared for hours at the most incredible night sky I've ever seen before the dawn slowly started to rub out the stars on the horizon and the multiple shooting stars faded away.
sents.cn: 凌晨3点半，我和九岁的女儿在旅馆阳台上毫无睡意，连续几个小时凝望着我生平见过的最令人惊叹的夜空，直到黎明缓缓抹去地平线上的星辰，道道流星也渐渐隐去。

sents.en: We were going to my wife's big family reunion in Auckland, New Zealand, but when we found out that Great Barrier Island, just off the coast, had been recently awarded Dark Sky Sanctuary status·a typically remote area that has an "exceptional or distinguished quality of starry nights"·we thought it would be the perfect place to relax before our busy schedule.
sents.cn: 我们原本要去新西兰奥克兰参加我妻子的大型家族聚会，但当我们得知，近海的大屏障岛最近获得了“暗夜保护区”地位——即一类通常极为偏远的地区，拥有“非凡或卓越的星空质量”——我们便觉得，在繁忙行程之前，那里是放松身心的完美去处。

sents.en: It's the first island and only the fourth location in the world to achieve this status.
sents.cn: 它是全球第一座岛屿，也是世界上第四个获此称号的地点

sents.en: After a 28-hour flight with two travel-sick children, our hearts sank when we saw the tiny twin engine 10-seater that was to take us the 90 km across the Hauraki Gulf to Great Barrier Island.
sents.cn: 带着两个晕机的孩子经历了28小时的飞行后，当我们看到那架要将我们越过豪拉基湾、飞行90公里送往大屏障岛的小型双引擎十座飞机时，心里直往下沉。但我们本不必担心。

sents.en: But we needn't have worried.
Whether it was the gravity force of the plane climbing or the noise of the engine, it put our three-year-old daughter instantly to sleep until we bumped down on the grass at Claris Airport.
sents.cn: 不知是飞机爬升的重力，还是引擎的轰鸣，让我们的三岁女儿瞬间入睡，直到我们在克拉里斯机场的草地上颠簸着陆。出乎意料地，我们的第一个呕吐袋竟是空的……情况开始好转。

sents.en: Our first empty sick bag against all the odds...
Things were looking up.
Great Barrier Island has no public facilities and the 950 people living there (though only about half permanently) rely on solar and wind energy, and bottled gas for cooking.
sents.cn: 大屏障岛没有公共设施，岛上约950名居民（虽只有约一半常年居住）依靠太阳能和风能，以及瓶装燃气做饭。这里没有路灯，没有自动取款机，也没有银行。

sents.en: There are no streetlights.
There are no cash machines or banks.
sents.cn: 警力由一对夫妻组成，邮递员只有一人。

sents.en: The police force comprises a husband and wife, and there's one postman.
It's not just the lack of light but the lack of noise that's so delightful on this unique and gorgeous scene.
sents.cn: 在这片独特而美丽的土地上，令人愉悦的不仅是光的缺失，还有噪声的缺失。

sents.en: It was first discovered by East Polynesians about 700 years ago and the Maori name for the island is Aotea.
sents.cn: 该岛约700年前由东波利尼西亚人首次发现，毛利语名称为Aotea。

sents.en: Captain Cook gave the island its European name, because it acts as a barrier between the Pacific and the Hauraki Gulf.
sents.cn: 库克船长赋予了它欧洲名称，因为它宛如一道屏障，横亘在太平洋与豪拉基湾之间。

sents.en: The climate here is subtropical like Auckland's.
sents.cn: 这里的气候与奥克兰一样，属于亚热带。

sents.en: The island boasts a beautiful wilderness with dense forests, glorious, unspoilt sandy beaches and plenty of bays and a few mountainous areas where there are good walking tracks among the wetlands and valleys.
sents.cn: 岛上拥有美丽的荒野，茂密的森林、壮观而未受破坏的沙滩、众多海湾，以及几处山区，湿地和山谷间分布着优质的步行小径。

sents.en: You can birdwatch, dive, surf and boat.
sents.cn: 你可以观鸟、潜水、冲浪、泛舟。

sents.en: The best beaches are on the eastern side of the island where the surf is better, too.
sents.cn: 最好的海滩位于岛的东侧，那里的浪况也更好。

sents.en: The sheltered western side is where you'll find the best diving and boating.
sents.cn: 避风的西岸则是潜水和泛舟的最佳去处。

sents.en: Lots of people come here for the fantastic fishing spots around the island.
sents.cn: 许多人慕名而来，只为岛周绝佳的钓鱼点。

sents.en: Like a lot of spots in New Zealand, there are whale-watching trips and you might just catch sight of sharks.
sents.cn: 如同新西兰的许多地方，这里也有观鲸之旅，你或许还能一睹鲨鱼身影。

sents.en: It's rare to find an island that really does feel undiscovered·but this is it.
sents.cn: 难得能找到一个真正令人觉得未经发现的岛屿——而这里就是。

sents.en: When one of my wife's relations, who comes here regularly, found out that we'd been there, he whispered to us, only half-joking: ·Shh·don't tell anyone!· The locals are a relaxed and friendly bunch·a lot of them told us that it's like what Waiheke Island (now in effect a suburb of Auckland) was in the 1970s when it was a commune of artists and people wanting to escape the city.
sents.cn: 当我妻子的一位常来此地的亲戚得知我们来过之后，半开玩笑地低声对我们说：“嘘——别告诉任何人！”当地人情松弛而友善——许多人告诉我们，这里就像20世纪70年代的怀赫科岛（如今实质上已是奥克兰的郊区），那时它还是艺术家和想要逃离城市的人组成的聚居地。

sents.en: Our guide for some of our stay was the inestimable Hilde Hoven, a Dark Sky ambassador who runs Good Heavens with Deborah Kilgallon and Orla Cumisky.
sents.cn: 我们在部分行程中的向导是无可估量的希尔达∙霍文，她是一位“暗夜大使”，与黛博拉∙基尔加伦和奥拉∙卡米斯基共同经营“GoodHeavens”。她们会把道布森式望远镜和豆袋带来（仰头惊叹若不靠颈枕支撑可是件累人的事），而且——我们的大女儿高兴地听到——还会把热巧克力送到岛上的任何地方。

sents.en: They bring their Dobsonian telescope and beanbags (it's hard work staring up wide-eyed in wonder without neck support) and, our elder daughter was glad to hear, hot chocolate to wherever you are on the island.
sents.cn: “说来奇怪，当初做光照测量时，”希尔达在解释该岛如何获得特殊地位时说，“他们发现北面的光污染其实来自约3000公里外的斐济，比南面奥克兰的还多。

sents.en: ·It's odd but when the light readings were done,· said Hilde, explaining how the island was awarded its special status, ·they found there was more light pollution on the northern side coming from Fiji, which is about 3,000 km away, than Auckland to the south.
sents.cn: 这里相当黑暗！”

sents.en: It's pretty dark!·

Beginning their astronomical PowerPoint demonstration using a green laser pointer, Hilde and Orla showed us the Messier 4 spherical cluster with white dwarf stars, Saturn and its rings, the Southern Cross and the Milky Way, which stretched across the sky.
sents.cn: 希尔达和奥拉用绿色激光笔开启天文PowerPoint演示，向我们展示了梅西耶4号球状星团（含白矮星）、土星及其光环、南十字座，以及横贯天际的银河。

sents.en: Our daughter was especially taken with Hilde's narrating of the Maori myth of Maui's fish hook to explain the shape of Scorpius.
sents.cn: 我们的女儿尤其被希尔达讲述的毛利神话“毛伊的鱼钩”所吸引，用以解释天蝎座的形状。

sents.en: In the fable, Maui hauled the North Island of New Zealand from the bottom of the ocean with his hook.
sents.cn: 在那个神话里，毛伊用他的鱼钩将新西兰北岛从海底拖出。

sents.en: We stayed at Mount St Paul's Estate, a luxurious lodge run by the friendly Chris and Teara, both from Canada.
sents.cn: 我们入住的是圣保罗山庄园，一家由来自加拿大的友好夫妇克里斯和蒂拉经营的豪华旅馆。

sents.en: Teara used to be a chef at the Langham in Auckland and so dinner, eaten around a huge circular table (made of one of the most ancient trees in the world), was every bit as mouth-watering as you'd expect.
sents.cn: 蒂拉曾在奥克兰的朗廷酒店担任主厨，因此，在那张由世界上最古老的树木之一制成的大圆桌旁享用的晚餐，正如你所期待的那般令人垂涎。

sents.en: Eating pancakes on the balcony overlooking the unspoilt white sandy beach was a great way to start the day.
sents.cn: 在俯瞰未受破坏的白沙滩的阳台上吃薄饼，是开启一天的美好方式。

sents.en: Another highlight was an hour-long walk to Kaitoke hot pools in the centre of the island, through wetlands and a forest, where we whiled away a good hour sitting in the pools shaded from the heat by layers of delicate umbrella-like plants.
sents.cn: 另一处亮点是前往岛中心凯托克温泉的一小时徒步，穿过湿地与森林，我们在层层精致如伞的植物遮蔽、免受酷热侵扰的池水中惬意地消磨了足足一小时。K)WealsolovedvisitingthepotterSarahHarrison,whoshowedusroundherstudioatShoalBayharbour,andhermanypotsandjugs,platesandbowlsandcolourfulmosaics.Inherwork,shealsousesalotofmaterialsfoundonthebeach.OurelderdaughterlovedthegorgeoushiddenpoolatMedlandsbeachwherethewaterisseparatedfromtheseainaprivaterockpool.OtherhighpointsweretheancientpohutukawatreesandtheincredibleviewsofOkiwiBasinandWhangapouabeachfromthetopofWindyCanyon,justa10-minutehikethroughanarrowvalleyupsomesteepwoodenstepsontheeasternsideoftheisland.K）我们也喜欢拜访陶艺家萨拉∙哈里森，她带我们参观了她在浅湾港的工作室，以及她的众多罐子、水壶、盘子和碗，还有色彩斑斓的马赛克。她的作品中还大量使用了在海滩上拾得的材料。我们的大女儿爱极了梅德兰兹海滩那处隐秘而美丽的池潭，池水与大海被一圈私人岩池隔开。其他高潮时刻，则是古老的波胡图卡瓦树，以及从风峡顶端俯瞰奥基维盆地和Whangapoua海滩的绝美景色——风峡位于岛的东侧，只需穿过狭窄山谷、爬上几级陡峭木阶，徒步十分钟即到。L)ApparentlytheislandcouncilturneddownfamousmusicianPaulMcCartney'sapplicationtobuyapropertyatGreatBarrierIslandbecauseoftheunwelcomeattentionhewouldhavebrought.Youcanseewhyhewantedtocomehere;equally,theislandknowsexactlywhatkindofstarwatchingitprefers.L）据说，岛议会曾拒绝了著名音乐家保罗∙麦卡特尼在大屏障岛购置房产的申请，因为他会带来不受欢迎的关注。你能理解他为何想来这里；同样，这座岛也清楚地知道它更中意何种“观星”。36.Theauthor'sdaughtersleptthroughoutthelastlegoftheirflighttoGreatBarrierIsland.36.作者的女儿在飞往大屏障岛航程的最后一段全程睡着了。37.Thelodgewheretheauthorstayedprovidedverydeliciousfood.37.作者所住的旅馆提供了非常美味的食物。38.ManypeopleareattractedtoGreatBarrierIslandbecauseoftheincrediblefishingsitesaroundit.38.许多人被大屏障岛吸引，是因为岛周令人惊叹的钓鱼点。39.Awell-knownartistfailedtopurchaseahouseonGreatBarrierIsland.39.一位知名艺术家未能在大屏障岛购得房屋。40.Unabletofallasleepafteralongflight,theauthorwaspleasedtoenjoythemostgorgeousviewofthenightskyinhislife.40.长途飞行后难以入睡，作者却欣喜地欣赏到了生平最绚丽的夜空景致。41.GreatBarrierIslandiscomparedtoanotherislandwhichattractedalotofartistsandpeoplewhowishedtostayawayfromcitylifehalfacenturyago.41.大屏障岛被比作另一座岛屿，那座岛在半个世纪前吸引了众多艺术家和想要远离城市生活的人。42.Onemostmemorablepartoftheauthor'svisittoGreatBarrierIslandwasaone-hourwalktoitscentre'shotsprings.42.作者此次大屏障岛之行最难忘的片段之一，是前往岛中心温泉的一小时徒步。43.GreatBarrierIslandhasoff
